Estimado Ernesto:

Le escribo para avisarle que la sesión con el comité de inversión de Fondo Mezcala se mueve del martes 19 de noviembre al martes 26 de noviembre, a las 11:00, en nuestras oficinas de Av. Patria 1150, piso 4, Zapopan. Dos de los miembros del comité no pueden estar el 19 y preferimos que los escuchen todos.

Para que el comité llegue con la presentación leída, le pedimos el PDF a más tardar el viernes 22 de noviembre a las 14:00. Le recuerdo lo que acordamos:

Máximo 15 láminas.
Cifras de 2023 completas y de enero a octubre de 2024, por sucursal.
El plan de compra del tostador de 15 kg, con la cotización del proveedor y el calendario de pagos.

Quedo atenta.

Lic. Paulina Arreola

Av. Patria 1150, piso 4, Zapopan, Jal.
33 3800 4127

messages.text:
Hi Olivia,

This was on the mat when we got back from Mexico: a £100 parking charge from Courtside Parking (£60 if paid within 14 days) for a car in the forecourt on 18 December at 21:40. It was a car-club car I had for about 20 minutes to load suitcases the night before our flight. Is the forecourt something you can sort out with them? Photo of the notice attached.

Thanks,
Luis

Dear Luis,

Thank you for your email and the photograph.

I'm afraid the forecourt at 14 Albion Road is managed by the freeholder's agent, not by Halden & Pryce or Mr Stavros, so we have no standing with Courtside Parking and can't ask them to cancel the charge. Your tenancy doesn't include a parking space.

You can appeal to Courtside directly using the reference on the notice. If you explain that you were loading for 20 minutes they may take that into account, but I can't say how they will decide.

Kind regards,

Olivia Marsh
Senior Property Manager
Halden & Pryce Lettings | 112 Stoke Newington Church Street, London N16 0LA
T: 020 7946 0312
This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
Fair enough, I'll appeal it myself. Thanks Olivia.

messages.text:
Hi Luis,

You ticked the box on the feedback form asking to hear what we did with it, so here's the short version of our retro from December. The full notes are on the website under Archive.

What worked: the shorter talks (20 minutes rather than 30), the quiet room, and the afternoon panel, which got the best scores of the day.

What we're changing:
- lunch: the queue hit 47 minutes at its worst, so this year it's two serving points and a staggered break
- captions on every talk, not just the keynotes
- name badges with pronouns as standard, not a sticker at the desk
- no more 9am start; doors at 9.30, first talk at 10

Your comment about the slides being unreadable from the back of the Red Lion Rooms made it in, almost word for word. Speakers get a minimum type size in their brief from now on.

Dates for this year:
- 2 June: call for talks opens
- 4 July: call for talks closes
- 4 December: Margins 2025, Red Lion Rooms, Holborn

Thanks so much,
Yasmin

Yasmin Farouk
Programme Lead, Margins - a conference about the edges of design

Margins 2025 call for talks closes
Margins 2025 at the Red Lion Rooms, Holborn

facts: The Margins 2024 lunch queue reached 47 minutes at its worst; 2025 has two serving points and a staggered break.
Talks went from 30 to 20 minutes; the afternoon panel scored best.
2025 changes: captions on every talk, pronoun badges as standard, doors at 9.30 and first talk at 10.
Luis's feedback about unreadable slides from the back led to a minimum type size in the speaker brief.
truth.summary: Yasmin sent Luis changes from the Margins 2024 retro, including shorter queues, captions on all talks and a minimum slide type size based on his feedback.

messages.text:
¡Hola a todos!

Chamba en Guadalajara. En Tueste Laja y Niebla buscamos ilustrador(a) para la temporada de fin de año en la sucursal de Providencia: una ilustración para la vitrina (2.40 x 1.20 m, en vinil) y la misma adaptada al pizarrón de caja y a tres formatos para redes. Entrega a mediados de noviembre.

Presupuesto: $12,000 MXN. ¿Les parece razonable? Prefiero preguntar antes que publicarlo afuera.

El archivo de vitrina lo recibe Inés, que lo manda a la imprenta.

Gracias, Mariana

Hola,

¿Qué uso tiene la ilustración después de la temporada? Si se queda en redes para siempre, $12,000 por vitrina, pizarrón y redes es poco. Si es uso por temporada, se puede platicar.

Rocío

Buen día,

Aclaro las condiciones de pago: 50% de anticipo y 50% a la entrega, contra CFDI. Los pagos se programan los viernes.

Atte. C.P. Emilio Cárdenas

C.P. Emilio Cárdenas Ruelas
Administración y Finanzas | Tueste Laja y Niebla S.A. de C.V.
administracion@lajayniebla.example

Hola a todos:

Yo trabajé con Tueste en su empaque y pagaron puntual, eso sí lo puedo decir.

Sobre el monto, coincido con Rocío: separaría el uso. Por ejemplo, la ilustración con uso en tienda y redes durante la temporada, y una licencia aparte si la quieren usar en bolsa o mercancía después. Así nadie se siente engañado en marzo.

Saludos,

Luis Cordero
Diseño de marca y producto
hola@luiscordero.example · +44 7700 900 418

¿Y el montaje en vitrina quién lo hace? Si lo tiene que pegar el ilustrador eso es otra cosa.

Toño

¡Hola!

Gracias, de verdad. Quedamos así:

$15,000 MXN + IVA.
Incluye uso en tienda y redes por un año. Bolsa o mercancía, aparte.
El montaje lo hace la imprenta, no el ilustrador.

Portafolios a mariana@lajayniebla.example hasta el miércoles 8 de octubre. Toño, si te interesa la vitrina para rotular otra cosa, escríbeme también.

Gracias, Mariana

keyDates.what: Portfolio deadline for the Tueste illustration job

facts: The job: a window illustration (2.40 x 1.20 m vinyl) for Providencia, adapted to the till blackboard and three social formats, due mid-November 2025.
Final terms: $15,000 MXN + IVA, shop and social use for a year; bags or merchandise licensed separately; installation done by the printer.
Payment terms (Emilio): 50% advance, 50% on delivery, against a CFDI; payments scheduled on Fridays.
Luis told the list Tueste paid him on time for the packaging job.
Inés receives the window file and sends it to the printer.
truth.summary: Mariana asked the list whether $12,000 MXN was fair for a seasonal illustration at Tueste Laja y Niebla's Providencia café; after Rocío and Luis suggested separating usage and Toño asked about installation, she set it at $15,000 MXN + IVA with a year's shop and social use, installation by the printer.

messages.text:
Hiya Luis,

How was the wedding?! Last time I saw you, at Ben's birthday, you were still rewriting your toast on the back of a beer mat, so I want a full report, and the Spanish half translated.

Anyway, practical thing. Niamh said when we had coffee before she flew out that you two are moving in June and that you'd need a van. Ben can get a Luton van through work for £85 a day instead of the £140 everyone else charges, but he has to book at least three weeks ahead and they only have two. So my suggestion: he books Saturday 20 June now, and if the date moves we can swap it, they're quite relaxed about that. Ben would drive if you want, he likes driving big things and pretending he's in a lorry.

facts: The Harrogate staff pilot ran 28 September to 7 October 2026 with 11 staff and 34 friends and family.
Point 3: 4 of 11 staff read the points badge as a price.
Point 5: 6 of 34 stopped at the date-of-birth step on the join screen.
Scanning at the till averaged 4 seconds; the points balance was right in 40 checks.
Pennywort owns points 2, 4 and 6; Acme owns 3 and 5.
Lorna Sykes, Pennywort's Brand & Marketing Manager, wrote the retro notes.
truth.summary: Steve forwarded Pennywort's Harrogate staff pilot retro and wants Acme's view on points 3 (the points badge reads as a price) and 5 (date of birth asked before saying why) before the 3 November review; Luis passed them to Marcus to draft by 16 October, and nobody has replied since.

messages.text:
Hi Luis,

Holloway staging has been broken since Wednesday's deploy. The CMS import throws an error on any entry with an image, so I can't load the museum’s 41 sample entries, and Anil's away until Monday 12th. I've rolled back a build before at my last job. Could you ask Jake to give me admin on the build server for a week so I can put staging back to Tuesday's build myself?

Z

Zainab Bello
Content Designer, Acme Studio
acme.example

Jake, could Zainab get admin for a week to roll Holloway staging back? Anil's off until the 12th and she's got 41 sample entries stuck on import. A rollback would let her test the images while we wait for the museum copy. We’ve got till 12 November now, but I’d like to clear this today.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Lead Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

sorry, no. build server admin is engineers only, it's in the insurance terms. rhys can roll back

Jake

I've asked Rhys to take the rollback today.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Lead Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Hi Luis,

Rhys rolled staging back on Friday evening. Image import works on Tuesday's build. All 41 sample entries are in. Still waiting on the final collection copy from the museum.

Z

Zainab Bello
Content Designer, Acme Studio
acme.example

made you a read-only login for the build logs so you can see when a deploy breaks something. still no admin

Jake

othersOwe: Holloway Museum: outstanding final collection copy

keyDates.what: The deploy that broke staging
Rhys rolled staging back to Tuesday's build
Anil back
Holloway launch

facts: The CMS import failed on any entry with an image after the 30 September deploy.
Build server admin is engineers only under Acme's insurance terms (Jake).
Rhys rolled staging back to Tuesday's build on Friday 2 October.
All 41 sample entries loaded; the final collection copy was still outstanding on 5 October.
Jake gave Zainab a read-only login to the build logs.
truth.summary: Holloway staging broke after a deploy on 30 September 2026; Luis asked Jake to give Zainab build-server admin, Jake politely declined (engineers only) and Rhys rolled staging back instead, so her 41 entries are loaded; Jake later gave her read-only access to the build logs.

Ya quedó instalada la señalética en las dos sucursales, se ve muy bien. Quiero fotos para anunciar el cambio en redes. ¿Le puedes pedir a Ximena? Algo rápido.

Saludos, Ernesto

En Providencia, el letrero de afuera también prendido y el pizarrón con los precios de temporada. Si te da tiempo, la puerta del baño de Providencia. Quedó tan buena que hasta le tomé una foto toda chueca con mi teléfono.

Ernesto, te arreglas directo con Ximena como en agosto. Esto va aparte de la marca.

Un abrazo,

Luis Cordero

hola@luiscordero.example · +44 7700 900 418

Medio día en las dos sucursales: $8,500 MXN + IVA, 25 fotos retocadas, entrega en 5 días hábiles. Las de noche (el letrero de Providencia encendido) van aparte, $1,800. Puedo el sábado 24 o el martes 27. Si es el sábado, arrancaría a las 8:30 en Chapultepec y regreso a Providencia cuando oscurezca. Para apartar pido el 50% y te mando los datos por separado.

X

Aprovecho que está en copia. Ayer venció el saldo de la marca, $43,000 MXN + IVA. Le mandé el CFDI el 15 de septiembre. ¿Me confirma cuándo puede salir la transferencia? Inés ya tiene los PDF del día 12. Mariana me pidió los editables el día 1. Se los mando a Inés cuando quede liquidado.

Saludos,

Luis Cordero

hola@luiscordero.example · +44 7700 900 418

Buen día,

¿Me reenvía el CFDI del saldo, PDF y XML? Necesito ambos para programar el pago del viernes 30.

Atte. C.P. Emilio Cárdenas

C.P. Emilio Cárdenas Ruelas
Administración y Finanzas | Tueste Laja y Niebla S.A. de C.V.
administracion@lajayniebla.example

Qué tal Luis,

Lo de la marca la próxima semana sale sin falta. Emilio ve el día.

Hey Luis!

Can I show the Tandem dock retry at the offsite? Priya’s given me ten minutes after lunch on Thursday 5 November for something people haven’t seen. I’d show the two retry states side by side: https://prototype.acme.example/tandem/still-unlock. It takes about four seconds to see why nobody knew whether to tap again.

Chiara said in September to keep it in the Tandem team until their board has seen it. We’ve got the readout next Wednesday but I don’t know when the board sees it. Does a room full of Acme count as internal for this? If it’s a no I’ll do the Pennywort points animation. Marcus is fine with it. Might need to spend my ten minutes trying to stop everyone talking about the badge again.

Priya’s off from Monday so I need to tell her which one tomorrow. Captions are still fine for Monday noon.

Gabi
